can we talk about inflation for a second? because the numbers can be a little misleading 😅

october's consumer price index rose 0.4%, compared with 0.6% in september
sounds like an improvement, right?

well, prices are still rising. they're just rising more slowly than they did the previous month
and foodrices increased 0.5% in october
but here's where things get uncomfortable for our wallets

bank of america and td securities economists are now predicting three consecutive fed rate hikes, starting in december

that's potentially more expensive borrowing for households already dealing with rising everyday costs

personally, i think that's the part of the inflation conversation we should be having more often

slower price increases don't mean your grocery bill is getting smaller. and if interest rates climb too, carrying debt could become even more expensive

my approach? keep an eye on recurring expenses, avoid carrying expensive credit card debt where possible, and leave a little breathing room in the monthly budget

because your grocery bill doesn't care how encouraging the economic headlines sound  😂

DTCC announced on November 12 that it plans to make eligible assets held at its subsidiary DTC available in tokenized form on Solana in the second half of 2027.

The details from the announcement and press coverage:

DTCC’s tokenization service went live on October 28 on Canton Network and DTCC’s private Besu network, with more networks planned for 2027. Twenty participants signed up at launch, including Bank of America, Citi, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley and UBS. DTCC says tokenized assets on Solana will keep the same investor protections, ownership rights and regulatory safeguards as traditionally held securities.

This is a plan, not a deployment. The asset list beyond “eligible” DTC-held assets has not been published, and the date is a half-year window.

For founders building tokenization products, the signal is where the first public-chain settlement flow will sit: with custodians and an existing legal wrapper, not with new issuers. Teams that plan to touch this market should start with the question of which assets will be eligible.
